I replied to Ilse in a #north-team thread on her message to confirm I've noted the figure: Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is 261 seats.

I looked for Quarrendon files in the share to check the number against, but found none, so I couldn't confirm it. For now her message and my thread reply are the only record. Seat counts count as operational facts, not finance figures, so posting it in the team channel was allowed.
